notes: v647 - tapping a share in Today's picks now opens the full share console - the chart, its history, the evidence behind it, your diary notes and the buy controls - instead of only the printable report card. The ticker itself is a link, and there are two buttons on each pick: Open takes you to the console, Report opens the printable card as before. If a pick names a share this device has not downloaded yet, it says so plainly and offers the report card instead, rather than the old dead end of 'Share not found'. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
